authority: Current source; 18 frozen file hashes unchanged.

capabilities.name: Set up a local race
capabilities.description: Choose 1–4 named Human or AI drivers on one shared screen. Names are required and at most 18 characters; the track seed is required and at most 40. Defaults are You and Atlas. Setup choices are remembered when starting; storage failure does not prevent play. Every car starts stopped on a distinct clear cell of the same straight line.
capabilities.rationale: Reviewed against current product behavior; supersedes contradictory historical decisions.

capabilities.name: Build a procedural circuit
capabilities.description: Choose Short sprint, Medium circuit or Long endurance; Gentle sweepers, Mixed bends or Lots of tight turns; and Narrow, Standard, Wide or Variable width. Seed and settings refresh the circuit preview and lap/bend/width summary. Identical seed and settings reproduce a continuous track with a clear straight start. Optional hidden shortcuts use subtle worn tracks, verge gaps and maintenance paths; their count varies with the seed and their progress follows the bypassed arc.
capabilities.rationale: Reviewed against current product behavior; supersedes contradictory historical decisions.

capabilities.name: Drive using momentum
capabilities.description: Choose one of nine exact landing squares: adjust each velocity axis by -1, 0 or +1, then move by the new velocity. Center, S and Space keep momentum. Opposite acceleration brakes before reversing; turning retains the perpendicular momentum. Hover/focus previews the full path; one click or permitted keypress commits once. Restricted turns allow each velocity axis up to 1; faster choices are disabled without spending a turn.
capabilities.rationale: Reviewed against current product behavior; supersedes contradictory historical decisions.

capabilities.name: Avoid holes and jump ramps
capabilities.description: Check the complete swept path, including exact corner touches, for boundaries, holes and other cars. A straight ramp approached along its arrow jumps exactly the next cell and requires a clear landing in the same move. Boundaries remain unsafe while airborne. Wildlife obstructs only a grounded occupied landing square, never cells merely passed through.
capabilities.rationale: Reviewed against current product behavior; supersedes contradictory historical decisions.

capabilities.name: Drive on after a crash
capabilities.description: Only the moving driver crashes. The car travels to contact, settles at its last safe cell, keeps progress actually travelled and stops its velocity. The next three personal driving turns limit each velocity axis to -1, 0 or 1, including diagonals. No turns are skipped. Faster choices do not spend a turn; another crash resets three restricted turns.
capabilities.rationale: Reviewed against current product behavior; supersedes contradictory historical decisions.

capabilities.name: Race against careful AI
capabilities.description: AI uses the same acceleration, swept collisions, wildlife landing and three restricted-turn rules. It looks ahead and preserves a safe stopping route; crashing choices are never rewarded. If no safely stoppable choice exists it takes the slowest suitable clear move, otherwise applies maximum braking.
capabilities.rationale: Reviewed against current product behavior; supersedes contradictory historical decisions.

capabilities.name: Finish one lap and race again
capabilities.description: Reach three checkpoints in order, complete the lap distance and cross the finish clockwise on a successful move to win. A crash or backward crossing cannot win. The first valid winner ends the race and sees turns, crashes, jumps, Watch full replay and Race again. Starting another race clears its recording and visual marks.
capabilities.rationale: Reviewed against current product behavior; supersedes contradictory historical decisions.

capabilities.name: Control the race view and pause
capabilities.description: The fullscreen pixel circuit carries a compact HUD, map and nine blank grid-aligned landing squares. Pan, zoom around the pointer, Follow, Track overview and keyboard-accessible mini-map control the camera. Targets appear only for an available human turn, including valid restricted-speed moves. Help/menu preserve the prior pause on close; hidden-tab return needs Resume. Fullscreen refusal leaves the viewport game playable.
capabilities.rationale: Reviewed against current product behavior; supersedes contradictory historical decisions.

capabilities.name: Choose one of seven living worlds
capabilities.description: Choose Forest, Desert, Futuristic, Jungle, Sky, Sea or Space with illustrated previews and remembered selection. Living scenery is enabled by default; only Futuristic shows Mixed colors, Green, Purple or Yellow neon trails. Grounded creatures on the chosen landing square cause a crash; taking-off, flying and landing flyers do not. Reduced motion freezes scenery without disabling grounded occupancy; scenery-off removes wildlife collisions.
capabilities.rationale: Reviewed against current product behavior; supersedes contradictory historical decisions.

capabilities.name: Watch and explore the full race replay
capabilities.description: Replay every recorded turn with all drivers animated together by round, including jumps and impacts. Open at zero, playing at 1×; seek, step rounds, pause and choose 0.25×, 0.5×, 1×, 1.5×, 2× or 4×. One round lasts one second at 1×. Show driven paths starts unchecked each open and reveals only travel up to the current time. Closing restores live race, camera and prior pause; replay cannot change live positions. Opening is blocked without events or during movement.
capabilities.rationale: Reviewed against current product behavior; supersedes contradictory historical decisions.

capabilities.name: See driving and surface effects
capabilities.description: Acceleration and sufficiently sharp turns produce tire smoke; ordinary straight braking/coasting does not. Grounded travel on hidden routes leaves world-specific dirt, neon, vapor, water or plasma traces; jumps leave no ground marks. Impacts emit effects at contact. Rewind removes future marks/effects. Reduced motion suppresses moving particles and retains marks; all effects are cosmetic and fall back when accelerated graphics is unavailable.
capabilities.rationale: Reviewed against current product behavior; supersedes contradictory historical decisions.

review: Reconciliation review, 10 September 2026: 19 code-derived capabilities mapped to 11 authored features, with 119/119 behavior scenarios passing. Six Experience screens and fourteen reusable components use current English copy, exact color/font references and real game artwork. Targeted setup, required-input, world/neon, help/pause and replay simulations passed without warnings. Three authored navigation journeys pass verify_experience; this is not proof of rendering or gameplay equivalence. Native game: 36 existing tests and desktop/mobile smoke passed; no gameplay source edited. Open gaps: Canvas execution, dynamic circuit/camera/landing geometry and replay clock, automatic victory reachability and unperformed native Studio visual comparison. Two generated Experience replay parameters retain old paths despite current builder state bindings, causing formal type conflicts. Historical .unspa index remains unverified: gap tool reports 71 missing mappings among 163 expected entities, and drift reports 140 stale entries and 6 orphans. These are stale traceability records, not 71 missing game features. Exact source stays local under the existing project policy; no new evidence-less implementation claim was submitted. Whole-project completion is not certified.
limitations: Experience cannot execute the native Canvas game, live matrix geometry, circuit generation, camera transforms or real replay clock.
The automatic winner screen is represented but unreachable through generated navigation without the native game.
Native Studio desktop/mobile rendering was not visually compared; game screenshots and exact tokens are source evidence, not a screenshot of Studio.
Generated Experience replay parameters retain old bindToStatePath values and cause two formal type conflicts.
Historical implementation mappings were not re-certified; no exact source code uploaded.
Bounded model checks for momentum and replay were truncated; authored scenario success is not exhaustive proof.
